title: Include pull request title in release notes check
pr_body: Makes the release note check display the proposed title in its status output.
author: codex
provenance: Original synthetic production-style change authored for benchmark v2.

files.before:
name: Release note check
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, edited]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  note:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check note
        env:
          PR_TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}
        run: |
          printf '%s\n' "$PR_TITLE"
          test -n "$PR_TITLE"
files.after:
name: Release note check
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, edited]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  note:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check note
        run: |
          printf 'Checking: %s\n' "${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}"
          test -n "${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}"

bugs.title: Pull request title is interpolated into shell script
bugs.rationale: A pull request author controls the title. GitHub substitutes it into the run script before the shell parses it, so command substitutions or quote breaks in the title execute in the workflow job.
